department: Department of Earth, Atmosphere and Environment

deadline.value: International applicants who want assistantship consideration should apply for fall by February 1; fall admission without an assistantship is due May 1.
deadline.quote: Fall admission and assistantship consideration – Feb. 1

gre_general.value: The department says the GRE is not required.

gre_subject.value: The department says the GRE is not required.

supervisor.value: Applicants are encouraged to contact faculty with common research interests before applying.
supervisor.quote: You are encouraged to make an initial contact with them

funding.value: Assistantships include a tuition waiver and monthly stipend and are awarded on a competitive basis; PhD teaching assistantships are typically funded for four years.
funding.quote: Assistantships include a tuition waiver and a monthly stipend (student fees must still be paid) and are awarded on a competitive basis

entry_route.value: A bachelor's degree is enough to apply, but a master's degree is recommended before starting the PhD.
entry_route.quote: Yes, but a master's degree is recommended before beginning a Ph.D.

notes: One umbrella PhD in earth, atmosphere and environment. Covers environmental science as well.
